# TourBandung Corporate

> Specialist B2B corporate outing, team building, and executive offsite provider in Bandung & Jawa Barat. Unit of 7Summits Travel. Operating since 2018 with 400+ delivered events for Indonesian companies.

## Key Facts

- 400+ corporate events delivered since 2018
- 100+ Indonesian companies trusted us
- 92% repeat booking rate
- 60+ venue partnership in Bandung & Jawa Barat
- Operating area: Bandung, Lembang, Ciwidey, Pangalengan, Subang, Jawa Barat
- Largest event handled: 1,200 pax 3-day program
- Average response time: 6 hours (working hours)
- Team senior tenure: 4+ years average
- Industries served: Technology, Banking, BUMN, FMCG, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare, Education, Media

## Differentiators

- Specialist B2B corporate vendor — not generalist travel agent
- Senior planner dedicated per project (not rotating freelancer)
- Direct venue relationships (60+ partners, not reseller)
- Pricing transparency — detailed line-item breakdown, 0% hidden fees track record
- Indonesian B2B market expertise — corporate culture aware

## Parent Brand

Tour Bandung Corporate is a specialized B2B unit of 7Summits Travel — a Bandung-based travel and event company that pivoted into specialized corporate experience design in 2018 after noticing the distinct needs of B2B vs leisure clients.
